Katherine Region - Victoria Highway - Watch Creek - Bridge Abutment Reconstruction and Reinstatement

A general outline of the work to be carried out under the Contract comprises excavation of the pavement on bridge approach on the Western end, test density of sub-grade, stabilise sub-base, prepare base course and seal it such that the settlement on bridge approach is rectified and smooth pavement transition to bridge is obtained.
